The psalmist is speaking of Yahweh seeing and knowing everything he does as if his **ways** were physical paths that are visible **before** Yahweh. Your language may have a comparable expression that you can use in your translation, or you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [for you see everything I do]

From this verse through verse 175, the psalmist is expressing his desire that something will do something using third-person verb forms. Here he wants his **cry** to **come near** to Yahweh. See the discussion in the introduction to Psalms about “let” and “may” and follow the decision of your team of how a speaker will express in this context what he wants someone to do. Alternate translation: [I desire that my cry would come near to you]
